description: Server-side routing catalog for the WorkFlow AI assistant. The catalog routes intent, scope, and parameters only; existing Django tools/services remain authoritative for permissions, business rules, and database writes. Confirmation policy is centralized once in global_rules[0] and enforced deterministically in ai/orchestrator.py; per-rule confirmation_phrases are presence markers only.
global_rules: Confirmation policy (single source of truth for every confirmation-required rule): 1) Never execute a mutation on the first request; store an exact frozen preview (tool name + arguments, or exact target record IDs) as the conversation's pending workflow first. 2) An affirmative reply (yes/ha/haan/हा/ok/okay/done/confirm/submit/send it/go ahead/no changes send it, and similar short affirmatives) executes ONLY the immediately preceding pending preview for the same authenticated user/session - never an older or unrelated pending workflow. 3) The preview must not be re-interpreted, widened, or rebuilt from the confirmation text; execute the exact frozen tool name and arguments captured at preview time. 4) A pending preview expires after a short window and is cleared immediately after execution, rejection, or expiry so a later standalone 'yes' can never replay an old action. 5) Any message that is not a recognized affirmative for the live pending preview clears that preview instead of executing it. 6) This confirmation matching, expiry, and frozen-payload execution is enforced deterministically in the AI backend (orchestrator), not decided by the language model.

Scope precedence is strict and never self-broadens: SPECIFIC_EMPLOYEE (one explicitly named employee) > explicit TEAM > PERSONAL (my/mine/me) > COMPANY_WIDE. 'my'/'mine' never becomes team or company scope; a named employee never becomes 'everyone'; company-wide access is never granted by the AI itself.
Prefer the highest-confidence, most specific matched rule over a generic/overlapping one (e.g. 'cancel all my leaves' or 'cancel <employee>'s leaves' must win over generic 'cancel leave').

Never invent request IDs, employee names, teams, dates, deadlines, balances, statuses, or success results. Optional tool fields must be omitted when unknown - never send null or a placeholder for an optional field.

Every create/update/destructive/bulk mutation follows preview -> frozen pending payload -> immediate confirmation -> exact tool execution. Bulk/destructive actions always require this even if requested before.

Backend tools/services remain the sole authority for permissions, dates, balances, status, ownership, duplicate/overlap checks, and all database writes. The rule catalog only routes; it never decides business truth and never writes the database itself.
Reporting arithmetic (attendance hours, percentages, leave duration, payroll, task counts) is computed deterministically by the backend report tools, never estimated or recalculated by the model.
Scheduled/future reminders are unsupported (the Notification model has no scheduled timestamp); never convert a future reminder request into an immediate notification - tell the user plainly instead.
